name: Ashwagandha
effects: HPA axis modulator — reduces cortisol, attenuates stress response
Among the best-evidenced adaptogens with multiple RCTs
KSM-66 (root extract) and Sensoril (root+leaf) differ in withanolide profile
Improvements in anxiety, sleep quality, and strength demonstrated in trials
Sedating — take at night for most people
Rare liver injury reports — likely adulteration but caution warranted; cycle use
